Production trainer - GMP/Aseptic work/cleanroom 
Would you like to use your experience in biotechnological production to train and inspire others? Are you passionate about quality, GMP, and sharing knowledge? Then this position at Biotech Training Facility is exactly what you're looking for! 
 Tasks and Responsibilities 
As a Production Trainer, you are the face of our hands-on training programs. You ensure that participants not only understand what GMP, aseptic processing, and cleanroom behavior mean, but also why they are so important. 
You will: - 
Deliver both practical and theoretical training on topics such as aseptic techniques, cleanroom behavior, and production processes under GMP conditions. - 
Coach participants on skills, behavior, and quality awareness. - 
Adapt training sessions to the participants' background and experience level. - 
Contribute to the development of new interactive training modules and learning materials. - 
Collaborate with fellow trainers and subject matter experts to continuously improve our programs. - 
Ensure that production and laboratory equipment remain up to date. Skill & Experiences 
You are someone who enjoys sharing knowledge, explains concepts clearly, and gets energized when a group learns something new. 
In addition, you have: - 
At least 5 years of experience in a GMP environment, preferably within (bio)pharmaceutical production. - 
In-depth knowledge of aseptic techniques and cleanroom processes. - 
Teaching or coaching skills, or the ambition to further develop them. - 
A practical, proactive, and quality-focused attitude. - 
Strong communication skills in both Dutch and English. - 
MBO/HBO/WO working and thinking level (through education or experience) in a Life Sciences discipline.

As a delivery driver at Albert Heijn Online, you are available at least two shifts per week. You are able to lift heavy boxes and you can work at various locations throughout the country. What else is important to know:

- You speak English or Dutch;
- You are in possession of a driving license B;
- You are available at least two shifts per week.

What will you do
Delivering groceries at the door is what you will do as a delivery driver at Albert Heijn Online! It puts a smile on your face every time! :) You leave with your own truck towards the right address. Have you arrived? Great, then it's time to drop off the groceries at the door! Unless they tell you otherwise of course. In addition to this task, there are more activities that you need to do. You also process payments and you lift the boxes to the front door! Sometimes, you drive to different locations within the country. You never know what your working day will look like! If you have any questions about your route, planning and support is always available!

- Working days: Monday to Sunday.
- Working hours: a shift between 5:00 AM and 3:00 PM and a shift between 1:00 PM and 11:00 PM.
